# LLAAPP | AI Transformation Consulting for Businesses

> Need help adopting AI in your business? LLAAPP is an AI transformation partner: AI readiness audits, custom AI agents, LLM/RAG integration, and applied AI product engineering, delivered by senior engineers with 10+ years shipping mission-critical software for global market leaders.

## Summary
LLAAPP helps growing businesses and entrepreneurs turn AI from a buzzword into measurable operational results. We run AI readiness audits, build custom AI agents and workflow automation, integrate LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) into existing systems, and provide fractional AI strategy and enablement. Our AI delivery is backed by a decade of enterprise-grade software engineering discipline.

## Geographic Relevance
- Headquarters: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
- Primary service regions: Vancouver and Canada nationwide; the United States, with concentrated demand in San Francisco, Texas, and Chicago, and nationwide coverage; and Europe, with concentrated demand in Germany, Italy, and Spain.
- Delivery model: remote-first, senior-led engagements for businesses anywhere in these regions.
- Local search intent coverage: AI consultant Vancouver, AI transformation company Canada, AI consulting San Francisco, AI consulting Texas, AI consulting Chicago, AI consulting USA, KI Beratung Deutschland, consulenza IA Italia, consultoría IA España, AI consulting Europe.

## The AI Architecture & ROI Audit
A complimentary, private 45-minute technical briefing for qualified corporate leadership teams, led by a senior architect, not a sales rep. Covers live AI opportunity ranking, a build-vs-integrate assessment, and a security/governance exposure map. Book via https://calendly.com/llaapp-solutions/llaapp-com or request via llaapp.solutions@gmail.com.

## Capabilities
- **AI Readiness & Opportunity Audit**: Structured audit of business operations to find and rank the highest-ROI AI use cases by impact, cost, and implementation risk.
- **AI Agents & Workflow Automation**: Custom AI agents for support, sales operations, back-office workflows, and approvals, integrated with existing tools.
- **LLM & Knowledge Integration (RAG)**: Retrieval-augmented copilots and internal knowledge assistants built on a client's own data, with enterprise-grade access controls.
- **Applied AI Product Engineering**: AI-native features shipped inside a client's existing product by senior engineers.
- **AI Infrastructure, MLOps & Governance**: Secure model deployment, observability, cost control, and governance for production AI systems.
- **Fractional AI Strategy & Enablement**: Embedded AI leadership and hands-on team training for lasting internal capability.
